question: Should maintainers land this no-deliverable-payload direct-message fallback now, or sequence it with the open yielded-completion and blocked-completion sibling PRs?
rationale: The patch looks correct, but it changes terminal delivery behavior that composes with other open session wake/message-delivery fixes, so landing order is a maintainer-owned risk decision.

options.title: Land after exact-head checks
